data.narrative:
Frankenburg Technologies is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company that has raised €40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 11 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies—comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 9 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Castelion.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the €40M raised as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to subsequent rounds, implies a valuation of €80M. Peer-median analysis across the 11-company comp set yields a median valuation of €1.0B, with a reported range spanning €125M to €3.0B; sample peers at Series B stage include Dream Security (€3.0B), Allen Control Systems (€2.2B), and Harmattan AI (€1.4B).

The triangulated analysis produces a range of €68M (low) to €1.1B (high), with a median of €540M. Stage-progression anchors the floor, reflecting Frankenburg's current funding position, while peer-median dominates the high end and median estimate. Key uncertainties include customer traction, technology maturity relative to the Series B peer set, and capital efficiency metrics not reflected in this data. The wide dispersion (€68M–€1.1B) reflects heterogeneity in the Defense & Security sector and stage-specific execution risk.
